name: Sha Lan
personality: Calm and caring; enjoys good food, drinks and socializing, and looks after Anatolia.
story: A 20-year-old from a western desert village in Kunlun who cared for the village children before joining the Pale Raven's Bridal Party in Dagshion. Recruitable only on Dietrich and Leda routes after clearing Anatolia's Paralogue and answering Saramis, Da Mina and Grounded Ship.

personalSkill.name: Cooler Heads
personalSkill.effect: After using Draw Back, unit can use assist magic. Lv 20: Watchfulness (Spd+2 to adjacent allies); Lv 35: Watchfulness+ (Spd+4).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier (mage support, Watchfulness Spd aura). Pocket Tactics: B tier.

build.notes: Bench in Part I. She joins after Anatolia's paralogue (10/5–10/14) at about Lv 25 in a Specialty class, hands Mu her Salamander, and trains Spear B in the Arena. Guardian in Part II Ch 2, a Bishop stint for Barrier in Ch 4 to 5, Sentinel in Part III.

guide.role: Res tank and Spd aura (spear Guardian)
guide.summary: A Part II Res tank who speeds up her neighbours. She joins after Anatolia's paralogue, sits out Part I, and from Part II stands in front of the mages next to Sirocco or Halvin: [[ability:Watchfulness+]] gives each adjacent ally Spd +4. A two-map [[class:Bishop]] stint adds Barrier (Res +3) to the same tile.
guide.playstyle: Stand on the tile that touches the most allies, facing the mages. Counter at range 2 with the Short Spear; cast Recover when nobody needs a spear.
keys: Clear Queen of the Erased by 10/14, then answer Saramis, Da Mina, Grounded Ship
Hand her Salamander to Mu the day she joins
Arena Mounted every week with Halvin: Spear B by 11/27 for Guardian (Spear is a boon)
Guardian in Part II Ch 2; Bishop in Ch 4 to 5 for Barrier if White B is there
Park her next to Sirocco: Watchfulness+ Spd +4 turns more tomes into doubles
watch: Res: Guardian adds 15% to her 45%, Hexlock Shield +5. She is the Res wall; Def 40% is not
Weight: Part II Bronze Spear +4 7 + Hexlock Shield 4 = 11 (4 over the weapon). Part III Bronze Spear +4 7 + Talisman Shield 3 + Healing Staff 3 = 13 (extra 6).
Spear B: about 7 Arena weeks from a mid-Ch 10 join. If it slips, Guardian moves to Part II Ch 3
Cooler Heads needs Draw Back, and how she learns it is unknown ?: plan around Watchfulness

decisions.topic: Take the Bishop stint for Barrier
decisions.pick: Part II Ch 4 to 5, then back to Guardian
decisions.why: Barrier (Res +3) lands on the same adjacent tiles as Watchfulness+ (Spd +4), so one tile gives both. It costs two maps of Guardian growth; skip it if White B isn't there by Ch 4.

decisions.topic: Wear the Hexlock, not a staff
decisions.why: Three healers already carry staffs, and her job is eating magic. Hexlock is 4 over the weapon, inside the hybrid budget of 6; a Healing Staff on top makes 7.

routeNotes.note: Partners here: Sirocco and Halvin, plus Nezha if you recruit him. Once she joins, seat Leda + Sha Lan + Sirocco on Ch 11 and 12 Sundays, then Leda + Sha Lan + Halvin.
Queen of the Erased (Anatolia, City Streets, 10/5–10/14) must be cleared to recruit her; it also gives the Electron Agitator.
